newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Spanish ambassador to Morocco fights off thieves.
newsitem.headline: Spanish ambassador to Morocco fights off thieves.

text.p: Spain's ambassador to Morocco fought off two would-be thieves this week who tried to snatch his wife's necklace, a spokeswoman for the Spanish embassy said on Friday.
Gabriel Ferran de Alfaro, 64, was returning with his wife, Dolores, from dinner at a colleague's house near Rabat's Hyatt Hotel three days ago when they were attacked.
"Two men on motorbikes tried to get the necklace of the ambassador's wife," the spokeswoman said, adding that the ambassador fought them off.
He was treated in hospital for slight injuries but was back at work the next day, she said.
